title: Eventual kernel vanishing for principal puncture restriction
statement: Let R be a Noetherian commutative local ring [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring] of depth at least three [def-weil-pbc-depth], let g lie in its maximal ideal, and let W be its punctured spectrum [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Put f:R to R/(g), I=ker(f) and W_n=openThickening f W n [lem-sbc-finite-etale-adic-sections-transfer]. For each n there is m at least n such that any two scalars a,b in R with the same canonical image in Gamma(W_m,O) satisfy a-b in I^(n+1). Thus the kernel of R/I^(m+1) to Gamma(W_m,O) maps to zero in R/I^(n+1). No injectivity of an individual finite-level restriction is asserted.

source.place: Tags 0H3E (Example 20.39.3, pro-isomorphism of the two-term cones with ordinary quotients), 0BLD (degree zero), 0BK0 and 0AVY; finite-stage specialization.

proof.text: Depth at least three implies depth at least two. Apply depth_two_puncture_globalSections_bijective and compose with GammaSpecIso.inv to obtain a bijective canonical ring map rho:R to Gamma(W,O_W). No H^1 vanishing is needed for the kernel assertion.

The punctured open is a Noetherian scheme. Apply exists_principal_section_stable_annihilator to rho(g) to choose c which kills all its local power torsion. For fixed n put m=n+c. Equal restrictions of a and b imply that t=rho(a-b) vanishes on W_m, since restriction is a ring map.

Apply principal_thickening_local_division to t. Choose local coefficients b_x on neighbourhoods V_x with t|V_x=g^(n+c+1)b_x. On overlaps the difference b_x-b_y is killed by g^(n+c+1), hence by g^c by the chosen bound. Therefore the local sections g^c b_x agree on overlaps. Glue them using the sheaf axiom to a section s on W. Restricting to the same cover proves t=g^(n+1)s. This is the proved private helper bounded_local_division_gluing.

Surjectivity of rho lifts s to r in R. Its injectivity gives a-b=g^(n+1)r. The quotient kernel I contains g; Ideal.pow_mem_pow and Ideal.mul_mem_right imply a-b belongs to I^(n+1). The bound m=n+c is at least n.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01YB and 01QQ give stabilized annihilators and local quotient divisibility. Direct sheaf gluing implements the kernel part of the pro-comparison in 0H3E, followed by canonical depth-two Hartogs (0AVY, 0BK0, 0E9I).

lean.statement:
theorem punctured_principal_restriction_kernel
    (R : Type u) [CommRing R] [IsNoetherianRing R] [IsLocalRing R]
    (g : R) (hg : g ∈ IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal R)
    (hdepth : (3 : ℕ∞) ≤ IsLocalRing.depth (R := R) R)
    (W : (Spec (.of R)).Opens)
    (hW : ∀ x : Spec (.of R), x ∈ W ↔ x ≠ IsLocalRing.closedPoint R) :
    let f := Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span {g})
    let I := RingHom.ker f
    ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ m : ℕ, n ≤ m ∧ ∀ a b : R,
      ((ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫
        (FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickeningMap f W m ≫ W.ι).appTop) a =
      ((ΓSpecIso (.of R)).inv ≫
        (FiniteEtale.Adic.openThickeningMap f W m ≫ W.ι).appTop) b →
      a - b ∈ I ^ (n + 1)
